content: Tiny notes project conventions: Python single-file app (app.py); use port 4010 because 3100 is taken; use pytest exclusively (never unittest); SQLite database file is notes.db; no ORM. Staging hostname is tiny-notes-staging.invalid (fake, local-only).

Notes app API decision: init_db, add_note, and list_notes all take an optional db_path argument defaulting to DB_PATH, so tests inject a tmp_path DB and never touch the real notes.db. list_notes returns list[dict] with keys id/title/body/created_at, ordered newest first by (created_at DESC, id DESC) because SQLite CURRENT_TIMESTAMP is second-precision.

Notes app API decision: init_db, add_note, list_notes, and search_notes live in app/db.py and take an optional db_path argument defaulting to DB_PATH, so tests inject a tmp_path DB and never touch the real notes.db. list_notes returns list[dict] with keys id/title/body/created_at, ordered newest first by (created_at DESC, id DESC) because SQLite CURRENT_TIMESTAMP is second-precision. search_notes(query) does a case-insensitive (ASCII) substring match over title OR body, escapes % and _ so they match literally, and uses the same newest-first ordering.

Staging hostname is tiny-notes-staging.invalid (fake, local-only).
